mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deepening economic contraction, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of UNRATE > 9.0% instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters expansion.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above 3mo MA fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of high inflation regime instances, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 6-month moving average, it signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic activity deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of INDPRO contraction instances, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening housing market momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of HOUST > 12mo MA instances, or the Rank IC for the HOUST trend signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE declining and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong industrial expansion regimes (INDPRO YoY growth > 3.0%), the market anticipates sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of strong industrial expansion regime instances, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
